english.title: Premises licence holder fail to notify licensing authority of change of name / address - Licensing
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the holder of the premises licence under the Licensing Act 2003 for **(..SPECIFY THE PREMISES AND LOCATION..), failed without reasonable excuse to notify the licensing authority for **(..SPECIFY THE AUTHORITY AREA..) of a change in

(A)_[your name]_
(B)_[your address]_
(C)_[your name and address]_
(D)_[the name of the designated premises supervisor]_
(E)_[the address of the designated premises supervisor]_
(F)_[the name and address of the designated premises supervisor]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 33 of the Licensing Act 2003.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure

english.notes: The holder of the premises licence is only obliged to inform the licensing authority of a change of name and/or address in relation to the designated premises supervisor when that supervisor has not himself done so.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level two on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
12 months
